titleEn: The k-th Lexicographical String of All Happy Strings of Length n
title: 长度为 n 的开心字符串中字典序第 k 小的字符串
summary: 开心字符串只含 a、b、c 且相邻字符不同，返回长度 n 的字典序第 k 个，不足 k 个则返回空串。
insight: 按 a、b、c 顺序回溯生成，完整字符串自然是字典序；计数到 k 时保存并提前终止。

solutions.title: 字典序回溯
solutions.idea: 按字母升序枚举所有合法前缀并在第 k 个停止。
steps: 递归中枚举 a..c，跳过等于末字符的字母
长度为 n 时 count++，等于 k 保存答案并向上传播停止

code.java: class Solution { private int count,k,n;private String answer="";private boolean generate(StringBuilder current){if(current.length()==n){if(++count==k){answer=current.toString();return true;}return false;}for(char value='a';value<='c';value++){if(current.length()>0&&current.charAt(current.length()-1)==value)continue;current.append(value);if(generate(current))return true;current.deleteCharAt(current.length()-1);}return false;}public String getHappyString(int n,int k){this.n=n;this.k=k;generate(new StringBuilder());return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private var count=0;private var k=0;private var n=0;private var answer="";private fun generate(current:StringBuilder):Boolean{if(current.length==n){count++;if(count==k){answer=current.toString();return true};return false};for(value in 'a'..'c'){if(current.isNotEmpty()&&current.last()==value)continue;current.append(value);if(generate(current))return true;current.deleteCharAt(current.lastIndex)};return false};fun getHappyString(n:Int,k:Int):String{this.n=n;this.k=k;generate(StringBuilder());return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int count=0,k,n;string answer;bool generate(string& current){if((int)current.size()==n){if(++count==k){answer=current;return true;}return false;}for(char value='a';value<='c';++value){if(!current.empty()&&current.back()==value)continue;current+=value;if(generate(current))return true;current.pop_back();}return false;}public:string getHappyString(int n,int k){this->n=n;this->k=k;string current;generate(current);return answer;} };
